title: How should a founder split between AI and humans
description:
Stop doing clerical work and start using AI for founders to scale your operations.

Determining the right division of labor is critical for modern teams. We break down which tasks you should automate versus the high-stakes responsibilities that require human critical thinking. This shift changes your hiring strategy from manual data roles to strategic business functions.

Subscribe for more practical AI workflows and business growth strategies.
